It includes the revision block, street name and limits title area, installation dates block, consultant company block with civil and traffic seals, scale bars and an index number box. Consultant block: Prepared under the direction of, company name, address, name, RCE No., date. Civil seal and traffic seal circles.

clean.title: Signal Plan Sheet Format (36" x 24" Sheet)
clean.summary: Blank LADOT sheet format for a traffic signal plan on a 36 by 24 inch sheet, shown rotated on the page. It includes a Notice to Contractor, a signal standard schedule, a conductor schedule, tables for estimated material furnished by LADOT and estimated salvage material to be returned to LADOT, a phase diagram, notes area, title block, seals and scale bars. Most fields are placeholders (XXXXX).
clean.notes:
Signal plan sheet format (36" x 24" sheet)
Notice to Contractor: numbered contractor notes on the sheet (text too small to transcribe reliably).
Signal standard schedule: columns for number, type, foundation type, pedestrian pushbutton type, phase, remarks. Notes area with placeholder entries.
Conductor schedule: cable/wire sizes and runs.
Estimated material furnished by LADOT.
Estimated salvage material to be returned to LADOT.
Phase diagram: eight phase boxes numbered 1 to 8.
Title block: As Built block, title, intersection number, file name, references, scale 1" = 20'.
Consultant block: company name, seals, RCE No.
